description: Controls runit services on remote hosts using the sv utility.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Whether the service is enabled or not, if disabled it also implies stopped. Choices: false true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the service to manage.

parameters.name: service_dir
parameters.description: Directory runsv watches for services. Default: "/var/service"

parameters.name: service_src
parameters.description: Directory where services are defined, the source of symlinks to service_dir. Default: "/etc/sv"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: started/stopped are idempotent actions that do not run commands unless necessary. restarted always bounces the service (sv restart) and killed always bounces the service (sv force-stop). reloaded always sends a HUP (sv reload). once runs a normally downed sv once (sv once), not really an idempotent operation. Choices: "killed" "once" "reloaded" "restarted" "started" "stopped"

examples:
- name: Start sv dnscache, if not running
  community.general.runit:
    name: dnscache
    state: started

- name: Stop sv dnscache, if running
  community.general.runit:
    name: dnscache
    state: stopped

- name: Kill sv dnscache, in all cases
  community.general.runit:
    name: dnscache
    state: killed

- name: Restart sv dnscache, in all cases
  community.general.runit:
    name: dnscache
    state: restarted

- name: Reload sv dnscache, in all cases
  community.general.runit:
    name: dnscache
    state: reloaded

- name: Use alternative sv directory location
  community.general.runit:
    name: dnscache
    state: reloaded
    service_dir: /run/service
